notes.title: MDM Surprise Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/4bb5b097b15b979ec2d4c8ae7eb83260fd071d40.png[/img]
[h2]New Restock Keyword[/h2]
Since the release of [b]Mayor Lindr[/b]⚡️a few months ago, two particular effects [i](Human Shield and Mayor Lindr)[/i] have occupied our imaginations. Both of these cards add new ones to the shop, similarly to other tokens generators, but there is a hidden flaw of [u]unlimited[/u] copy creation. 

The act of adding the same card over and over [i](Rally, Conversion, Dr. Daisy)[/i] requires heavy commitment from the beginning of the match, which is risky and boring at the same time. Peak game design...❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/4082b4d603d64657ee1df3fc2b62f015e060fde4.png[/img]

Packaging this multiplication functionality in a new [b]Restock[/b] keyword has opened an enormous number of possibilities. We no longer have to rely on Double and Triple effects, that while fun are a bit clunky, because the total price of cards has to be doubled or tripled.

 With this solution we can divide the large upfront cost⚡️⚡️⚡️ into a few smaller chunks ⚡️+⚡️+⚡️making the deckbuilding experience [b]friendlier[/b] and deck creation [b]quicker[/b]. The best part is the extra [u]flexibility[/u]! Too many copies of the same card can make the deck dull and uninspiring. Players will now be able to choose exactly how many cards they want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/5948cceb69fdf8b0852fc4303204a4e3ba0e165c.png[/img]

[h2]Metal Duke Mox Release Guide[/h2]
SUR5☢️ 30th Survivor - [b]MDM[/b] can be unlocked just for 2160🟨 credits or 525 💎 crystals! Cards provided by this advanced-tier, defense character create a strong foundation for all Barrier based archetypes. It's also a second character that pushes the design philosophy of Hybrid card type.

[i]"Decades of hoarding all things into one hand-shaped megastructure was considered insanity. Total Collapse has changed people's minds. They began to admire this act of unintentional resourcefulness and praised its creator as Metal Duke Mox. With the influx of attention, MDM had a sobering moment and left, but was no longer a slave to materialism."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/1fce2c8492e6160b861b2aed2a927b692dfa705b.png[/img]

[b]Metal Duke Mox[/b] has the simplest destroy effect of all available Survivors in the game. This unending hatred towards all consumer goods comes at the cost of his own health 🔥🔥🔥 To protect from self-harm and enemy invade cards, use [b]Fortify[/b] and manipulate metal waste around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/4a4f434684a1321a5615b581fcc03c69f5d108d6.png[/img]

He is not the only one in this fight and devoted Acolytes are glad to do everything their reverend prophet says. [b]Vandalize[/b] and [b]Reserves[/b] are both great ways to use barriers when there is no life loss 💔 threats present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/43d03b8578409a3cfc3cf6bb597912fec966b60e.png[/img]

[b]Balls of Steel[/b] and a good timed [b]Booby Trap[/b] is everything you need to completely stomp an opponent. These two (as well as other hybrid cards) don't do much damage 💀, but they can totally clog enemy decks! 💩💩💩

[h3]Suggested Companions[/h3]

[*] [b]Vex[/b] [i](Fixes energy issues and matches waste types)[/i]

notes.title: Hybrid Cards + Sister Senn Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c14201217bcd7c97d8b10627f1f7b36e16080e73.png[/img]
[b]Hybrid[/b] cards were in our plans since the very beginning of the game, awaiting their movement alongside [b]Sister Senn[/b]. We are very happy to finally awaken them from deep slumber. While at first glance the new card type might seem underpowered, it absolutely makes up for it with their extra versatility, DOUBLING the possibilites!!! 🖤❤️💜💙

How do they work!? It's very simple and elegant design! Players can purchase Hybrid cards by dragging them to either [u]top side[/u] of the screen [i](as Invade card for enemy)[/i] or to the [u]bottom side[/u][i] (as Basic card for their own deck)[/i] This truly innovative change will be a permanent feature that allows us to pack more SUR5☢️ into SUR5☢️ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/bdf46ce1c191c8fb8262e6594641bc0d02d52c61.png[/img]
[h2]Sister Senn Release Guide[/h2]
[b]Sister Senn[/b] can be unlocked for 4320 🟨 credits or 825 💎 crystals. Cards she brings to the bood stained table works very well on their own, but are most efficient when paired with other [b]Life Gain[/b] ❤️ Survivors. Her tanky kit and 4 Hybrid cards can extend game time to the new lengths!

[i]"Metal fangs drilled into Sister Senn's skull itch every time she spills blood. However, time for the pleasures will come later. First she needs to harvest and freeze organs of the donor. Lamashtu pays a fortune for body parts that closely match the necessary genetic profile..."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/edef9d070a15fcec9d97a367e84d09a673341c7f.png[/img]

Access to a vast DNA🧬 database of potential targets comes at a huge cost. All bloodlink agents must replace their teeth with metal implants that cause immense discomfort when their cravings are not satisfied. This modification ensures that pseudo-vampires are loyal and always happy to serve a bad cause 🩸🩸🩸

[b]Hunger[/b] 💀💀 [b]Direct Damage[/b] effects can be triggered with [b]Sister Senn[/b] or using traditional [u]Tweak effects[/u]! Be extremely cautious when gifting this to opponent as it can be easily turned against you 💔 💔 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/678d8a9e51f544f6a45d3c5a81fdee2e793f6e7b.png[/img]

[b]Transfusion[/b] can be a powerhouse or menace, depending if the deck has enough [b]Life Gain[/b]❤️effects. It's usually a good idea to wait a little before the purchase. Note the card description reads [i]"since last turn"[/i] meaning that effect includes life received from [b]Blood Agent[/b]💉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/8592055d1adfb49394ef642eb59d7611741571fb.png[/img]

[b]Deep Rest[/b] has by far the most powerful healing effect in the game, comparable to dealing 3 points of direct damage. It can put a [b]Hunger[/b] at the bottom of the deck, to be later drawn with [b]Stitched[/b] - triggering a draw bonus 🔥🔥🔥

In our pursuit of creating the very best deckbuilding game ever™ we also decided to change some of the older cards to make the Hybrid type feel more common. Similarly to the Spark update we will be consequently adding them from this point forward. We are super excited to see how players can use these newfound powers!

notes.title: Phoebe Release + New Defence Type
notes.notes:
[h2]Barrier[/h2]
The small things are often overlooked, but sometimes they are the most important. [b]Barrier [/b]mechanic is much simpler than many of you expected! It was designed to resolve the hidden issue with the basic Armor🛡️, but what's the problem?
 
Armor can stop both [b]Direct Damage[/b]💀 and [b]Life Loss[/b]💔 from invade strategies. We artificially limited this effect to a handful of cards because it can resolve both of the threats leading to unfun "[i]turtling[/i]" gameplay. With this new experimental effect we can stop invaders without relying on destroy cards, opening completely new deck archetypes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/15cb88e73656f7b61949ff8eb4ae3023d7fc926f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [h3]Armor stops direct Damage[/h3]
[*] [h3]Damage ignores Barrier[/h3]
[*] [h3]Barrier soaks Chemical Damage[/h3]
[*] [h3]Chemical Damage outwaits Armor[/h3]
[/list]
[h2]Phoebe Release[/h2]
We hope you enjoyed your time with the TRX release last month, because we already have the next Survivor for you! For 4320 🟨 credits you can unlock a very versatile character [b]Phoebe,[/b] who bridges the waste gaps between certain combos🔥🔥🔥

[i]Phoebe's high intellect couldn't protect her from hazy years of crystal abuse. Rotten arms would be amputated without the merciful intervention of Mayor Lindr. After losing empathy to the rest of society, this victim of Stockholm syndrome has pledged her life to a new[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/5afe699537aebff5d6118fcf46bb9ce0a6320c0e.png[/img]

[b]Forcefield [/b]is the first card with mentioned earlier [u]Barrier[/u]. It can stop a lot of mid-range invade cards like [b]Flat Earther[/b], while also providing their dual waste that normally would be "wasted" when destroyed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/5f470b5c1e3c8145bf99382a13be64cbe22818b9.png[/img]

[b]Phoebe's[/b] general strategy is to cumulatate massive amounts of energy or deal huge damage in one turn ([i]Traits: Attack-Foresight[/i]). We recommend waiting a few turns before purchasing her card, because it's not as effective in early phases as in late game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c12d119e6dde0c1e6694d49f22ae045a77caea77.png[/img]

[b]Watchdog[/b] is another experiment combining [u]text triggers with symbols[/u]. In this case the doggie needs to be played as the very first card in a round - the energy must be obtained from the previous turn using [b]Deploy[/b] or other store effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/8ad451b26cbb33ee967e7b0bf1ebfc414a78071d.png[/img]
This Survivor shares her card Frame with 2 others. Together they create a "faction" called NWG - [b][u]New World Government[/u][/b], where Mayor Lindr makes the laws and distributes mind-controlling drugs to the public. Phoebe commands police forces and Mrs B terrorizes the private sector. A truly disgusting and corrupt combination! 🤮 🤮 🤮

[h2]Momentum Changes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/75898cd7c54343f193d236ea932aeb539f785c7f.png[/img]

This interaction was not planned at all when we designed the [b]Double[/b] and [b]Momentum[/b] mechanic, but if its fun then why not embrace it? Thanks to folks who suggested this change! This type of "[i]secret[/i]" knowledge can create super cool situations and we are happy to explore this concept in future ❤️

[h2]Quick Start Bundle[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/ef350e4cfbe6e26b67d527cf7aedff318e090085.jpg[/img]
We are currently working on a big purchasable item that will grant new players access to [b]20 Survivors[/b] and all [b]Wildcards[/b] (Level 1). We believe that it's important to help people get to the game faster without having to grind all the items. Inside this pack there will be a hilarious [b]Casual Mrs B Skin[/b] available only there ([i]except next Braw[/i]l)! 😆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/709d4613f892bd5b7947894d56902a31cc46c9f3.gif[/img]

[i]Art update of Mrs.B character design. She has now black hair strand, belt full of ammo clips and golden knuckle-duster.[/i]

[h2]Hurricane Brawl[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/45a8f416cea98efc5234bf9ce498623f26f877a6.png[/img]
We encourage everyone to try all these changes and new Survivors during the Hurricane Brawl event that will take place next weeked ([i]22-23 February 2025[/i]) starting at 10 CET. There will be an active modifier that you might recognize from long time ago ❤️

Thank you so much for reading and hope to see you in game,

notes.title: SUR5 Release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=6mNLf9icUNU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][i]6 years ago our journey with SUR5 ☢️ started. Today we would like to share our 6 reasons why it began in the first place...[/i][/h3]

[h1]6 Reasons[/h1]

[h2]Gambling Epidemic[/h2]
Every year more and more games or even other products include [b]lottery elements[/b], loot boxes or boosters. Even when you buy pasta in a store there is a chance to win a luxury cooker. This is not how we remember the world. It became a new norm that prays on the [b]compulsive behaviours[/b] of the weakest. This false sense of control creates society that "hopes" something will change their lives instead of taking action.

[h2]Economic Crisis[/h2]
"The rich get richer and the poor get poorer". A story as old as the world, but taken to the extreme in 2025. By no means we are not opposed to accumulating wealth, but [b]extracting every penny[/b] in order to satisfy insatiable investors has gone too far. Our small game made by just 2 people is an inexpensive refuge for individuals who want to take a break from [b]predatory monetization[/b] and don't have to spend a dime while having fun.

[h2]Shattered Home[/h2]
We are aware that there are tons of incredible deck building games out there. We love those titles, but predominantly they are single player experiences that make us [b]disconnected from society[/b]. People keep jumping from one title to another repeating the same mechanics. SUR5 improves on a well established classic formula and together we can go even further. Creating a community where we share truly innovative mechanics.

[h2]Freedom of Speech[/h2]
The idea behind "Freeworld" (original title) was to create a post-apocalyptic world where no governments and companies can [b]censor[/b] our thoughts. A new beginning, big reset unlike what we have in real life... Apparently we can't handle the truth and need to be fed [b]constant lies[/b] and [b]misinformation[/b]. Disabling communication leads to creation of echochambers, separating people into groups and escalating real life conflicts.

[h2]Degenerating IQ[/h2]
The constant reliance on technology for every task prevents the formation of new neurons and memories. This leads to the creation of a less intelligent and easily [b]controlled society[/b]. SUR5 won't hold your hand. We believe in people's ability to understand complex ideas, learn and use their imagination. Hopefully these skills will help in building better reality for us all.

[h2]Reason #6[/h2]
Sixth reason? Hmm... I forgot what that was. Oh I know! Remember to have fun. Not everything has to be serious or competitive. Those old days where we could waste all day playing games, making silly jokes and talking to friends. Without building a thick skin and the ability to accept other people's viewpoints (instead of trying to change them) the world will become more [b]depressing[/b] each day.

[h1]Development[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/8768a143174038d44452f8253f92726bea138423.png[/img]

[i][h3]SUR5 might be one of the most ambitious indie games ever with over 160 000 lines of code and 800 hand painted illustrations made by just 2 people. Let's These highly advanced and specific mechanics be an inspiration for your own projects[/h3][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/b19d169fca22c4093d574f98275bb5ceb18a7eed.png[/img]

The best way to create your own game is to start with pen and paper allowing your own thoughts to guide you in decisions of what is fun and what isn't.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/923f33dda054fa3880c073fe198747253b5bd62d.png[/img]

Greyboxing is the first step of building a functional prototype. The goal is to polish very solid foundation before heading towards working on details.

notes.title: Werwent Release
notes.notes:
[h2]Werwent[/h2]

Local stories say that deep in the forest shadows lives a treelike cryptid nicknamed [b]Werwent[/b]. They claim that the beast escaped from a nearby botanical laboratory. No one knows the truth, but one is for sure: whatever haunts people during the night does it for its own twisted pleasure…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/ca88405b2ff8d762bfed63097c85595378bee295.png[/img]

Waste combos are the bread and butter of SUR5 game design. This integral part is definitely not going anywhere and the number of possible combinations is still increasing at exponential rate. While we want to promote creativity as much as we can, we would like to provide some counter measures to stop the most broken playstyles that can deal 7+ damage every turn!

This is how Werewent was born with its hallmark card - [b]Regenerate[/b]. It's definitely not the easiest to use, but it can counter crazy combos two times per game. We believe that this universal Survivor with expensive late game cards can provide a lot of value to any build.

[h2]Roadmap Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/75d3f3e22cac1913dea9e00a8563aac715a3829e.png[/img]

In the next few weeks we will be launching a [b]Battle Rage[/b] event that is similar in functionality to Wild Growth, but with different rewards. This core event will occur once a month (after game release) and it's the main source of Ashes of Destruction. Together with Seeds of Tomorrow, Atomic coins, Scraps and Sprockets we have necessary materials to introduce more advanced blueprints.

In our research we found that the biggest challenge for new players is inability to correctly connect the overwhelming number of cards (especially when it's one of their first games, when they simply had no chance to learn them all). While some players enjoy finding ad-hoc solutions based on incomplete information, many may be lost. Nonoptimal, slow or failed decks Is one of the main causes of premature exit.

To solve this unpleasant experience we are introducing an [b]Automatic Guiding System[/b]. This exciting feature will help new players by highlighting what they should purchase and why. If you worry that this function will replace skill, we'd like to ensure that the results are intentionally sub-optimal and they still need common sense to apply! Veterans can toggle-off this option in settings at any time.

After implementation of AGS, we will proceed with updating the [b]Tutorial[/b]: integrating the highlight system, removing unnecessary story elements, focusing on the clarity. We are standing in front of the bold task of teaching a complex game to a broader card game audience who might never engaged with deck builders. We appreciate all feedback and support <3

To spice up the waiting time for the final release we also decided to introduce our new damage type: [b]Chemical Damage[/b]. This exciting mechanic was in the works for many months and will be integrated to already released cards, as we believe it greatly increases the interactivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/3d1ab5c851bc283f53277a1e90ec8091d2dde870.png[/img]

We added a skin preview function to the game store! We greatly appreciate all your purchases that keep the SUR5 serwers rolling! There is entire Thank you!

Dear rebeliants! We have just released a new update that contains an important feature - [b]Leaderboards[/b]. It's a list that summarizes players' progress as they reach higher levels of enlightenment, but it's also a foundation for other systems planned ahead.

Our long-term goal is to reward exceptional achievements with special skins, invitations to tournaments and more. Menu can be accessed through the button underneath the player portrait with the number of [b]Total Player Power[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/39a212b81fdf658d9de357cb2820f39674b16607.png[/img]

[h1]Total Player Power[/h1]

The exact formula for Total Player Power is very complex and measures three main aspects:

[h3]Exploration[/h3]
takes into account mission completions (including difficulties levels), Steam achievements and Tutorial status.

[h3]Rivalry Power[/h3]
Takes into account participation in Casual Games. Brawl Games and Hall of Fame position.

[h3]Collecting Power[/h3]
Takes into account all kinds of unlockable things like Survivors, Wildcards, Skins, Styles, Frames, Badges, etc.

notes.title: Rapid Growth Event + 7 Card Rule Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/950877f19aa70977f96cb9965c551ce8773999cf.png[/img]
[h2]Rapid Growth[/h2]
In this event players can gather [b]Seeds of Tomorrow[/b] by playing Casual games between 6-7 January 2024. This cyclical event will occur every 2 months providing a stable income of our new currency. Seeds of Tomorrow (SoT) can be exchanged for both customizable or utility items and unlike Credits they can be traded between the players.

You might have noticed SUR5's very first [b]Blueprint[/b] for a Globe of Tomorrow (5 x Seed of Tomorrow + 2 x Sprocket). Currently this subcomponent has no usage, but we plan to expand crafting and recipes greatly in 2024. We are also very proud to show our latest skin: [b]Galactic Murad Skin[/b]. This is a long term goal, but luckily you don't have to do this alone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/99e4ae6489aa1ad43632fc4b216f6c2de90459a2.png[/img]
[h2]7 Card Rule[/h2]
Long time ago, during the testing of SUR5 we noticed that players who did not find energy generating cards were at significant competitive disadvantage. Gamers were forced to buy (only at the time) Survivor Murad. We knew that the correct solution was to add more starting options, but it required more time to develop and balance.

This came to the invention of "[i]7 card rule[/i]" - the first 7 cards in shop (after Survivors) were chosen from the 0-3 energy cost range of, pulling less expensive cards early while pushing powerful win conditions, making the game smoother….

Side effect of that approach was - predictability as the game partially played by itself. Patterns of purchasing 1-2 energy generators, 1 destruction card followed by damage combo that exactly fitted symbols become too obvious. Some cards like [b]Excavator[/b], [b]Carbon Copy[/b] or [b]Harvest[/b] were not needed at that point, blocking SUR5 from reaching its full potential.

Single point damage cards  (Sacrifice, Light it Up, Chemitrail - 0-3 energy range) became a dominant  strategy that was not exactly in the spirit of constructing decks. This experiment revealed that unconditional damage cards were not priced correctly and we do not plan on reducing their cost.

We have permanently removed the "7 card rule" from Casual/Brawl Game mode. The feeling of building a deck around a “bizarre”, “suboptimal” or “trash” card was what we were missing the most and we are happy to reintroduce it leading to more satisfying gameplay. 

We can't wait to see how SUR5 will develop in 2024 and we hope you will stay with us to see it's glory!
